summary_1line: After being rescued by the Pandavas from the Gandharvas, a humiliated Duryodhana travels home and confesses the truth of his defeat to Karna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Duryodhana sits on an elevated couch in the night camp, head bowed in shame like an eclipsed moon, while Karna approaches to speak with him.
Arjuna fills the sky with a dense net of arrows as Gandharvas flee through the air dragging the captive Kauravas behind them.
Arjuna and the Gandharva king Chitrasena meet mid-battle and embrace like friends while the Pandavas and Gandharvas lower their weapons around them.
